protocol: Real stdlib urllib HTTPResponse with chunked transfer encoding
finding: Even a single read1 call consumes an internally read chunk header; drip-fed framing defeats a deadline checked only between read1 calls.
implementation_constraint: Bound underlying framing reads or use a qualified whole-operation cancellation owner; changing read to read1 plus a clock check is insufficient.
cleanup: server shutdown, socket closed, worker joined
limits: Local characterization only; not installed matrix or production cancellation qualification.
